description: Four arithmetic sections, each taking two values and putting out their sum, their product and their quotient. The second value can be set on the section's own display to four decimal places

inputs.text: The first operand of that section
The second operand of that section, which replaces the value set on its display
While a cable is patched here, that section works out its results only when a pulse arrives rather than following its inputs continuously

outputs.text: A copy of that section's second operand, for passing the same value on to another section
The sum of the two operands; with nothing patched to A IN it carries 0 plus B
The product of the two operands; with nothing patched to A IN it carries 0 times B
The first operand divided by the second, while the second is not zero; with nothing patched to A IN it carries 0 divided by B

notes: each section's display holds its B value: drag it to change it, the further to the left the pointer the faster it moves, in steps down to 0.0001, and right click resets it to 0
the sections work on polyphonic cables, and the trigger input is always monophonic.
